title: Patient Advocate
summary: Serve as a liaison between patients, billing, and clinic staff; welcome new patients; resolve account and insurance issues; and help arrange financial assistance.
responsibilities: Educate patients about services and insurance, gather new-patient information, and verify coverage.
Identify referral or authorization needs before service and maintain authorizations for ongoing treatment.
Help resolve billing questions, arrange assistance or drug-replacement coverage, and establish payment plans.
qualifications: Two to three years of medical-office experience with front-office or billing experience.
High school diploma required; some college preferred.

title: Admixture Technician
summary: Compound chemotherapy agents under physician and pharmacy leadership while maintaining safe, accurate workflow and established policies.
responsibilities: Compound chemotherapy agents according to physician orders and follow OSHA and company procedures.
Support workflow, scheduling, team coverage, and training for new employees.
Read and communicate measurements accurately while safely handling vials, needles, syringes, and medicinal preparations.
qualifications: Strong organization, communication, mathematics, data-entry, and teamwork skills.
Two years of IV-admixture experience and chemotherapy experience are preferred.
High school diploma or GED required; national pharmacy technician certification preferred.

title: Medical Records Clerk
summary: Keep clinical records organized and accessible through careful filing, clerical support, and accurate use of office equipment and systems.
responsibilities: File reports in charts and charts in the appropriate files using alphabetical and numeric systems.
Operate standard office equipment and follow written and verbal instructions accurately.
Travel occasionally to UCS offices along the Wasatch Front.
qualifications: General clerical experience preferred, with exposure to medical terminology.
High school diploma or GED required.
The role includes frequent bending and stooping and lifting up to 50 pounds.

title: Patient Services Representative
summary: Welcome patients and visitors, coordinate scheduling, gather insurance information, and connect patients with the right clinical support.
responsibilities: Work Monday through Thursday in Ogden and Friday in Layton.
Greet, instruct, direct, and schedule patients while collecting accurate insurance and contact information.
Serve as a consistent liaison between patients and the medical support team.
qualifications: Clear communication, careful data entry, and confidence using standard office systems.
One year of medical-office experience and medical terminology knowledge preferred.
High school diploma or GED required.

title: Patient Services Representative
summary: Welcome patients and visitors, coordinate scheduling, gather insurance information, and connect patients with the right clinical support.
responsibilities: Greet, instruct, direct, and schedule patients while collecting accurate insurance and contact information.
Answer phones and assist patients in a busy reception setting with professionalism and care.
Serve as a consistent liaison between patients and the medical support team.
qualifications: Clear communication, careful data entry, and confidence using standard office systems.
One year of medical-office experience and medical terminology knowledge preferred.
High school diploma or GED required.

title: Physician Outreach Specialist
summary: Build and strengthen relationships with referring providers, increase awareness of UCS services, and support thoughtful growth across the service area.
responsibilities: Serve as the primary liaison between UCS and current or prospective referring providers.
Plan strategic outreach, maintain provider relationships, and communicate UCS physician, clinic, and service information.
Interpret referral data, identify trends, and recommend outreach initiatives; frequent local travel is required.
qualifications: Excellent relationship-building, communication, organization, and independent time-management skills.
A bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, healthcare administration, or a related field is preferred.
Healthcare marketing, provider outreach, business development, sales, or clinical experience is preferred.

title: Registered Nurse
summary: Provide professional nursing care for clinic patients using established standards, sound clinical judgment, and clear communication.
responsibilities: Assess patient needs, provide ongoing care, maintain records, and respond calmly in urgent situations.
Apply professional nursing standards, safety precautions, and clinic procedures throughout care delivery.
Travel to other UCS locations may occasionally be required.
qualifications: Graduate of an accredited nursing school with a current Utah registered nurse license.
Current BLS certification.
One year of professional nursing experience in a clinic setting preferred.

title: Registered Nurse Care Manager
summary: Coordinate individualized, comprehensive care and help patients, families, and caregivers move through every phase of the cancer-care continuum.
responsibilities: Assess patient needs and develop individualized care plans with the healthcare team.
Coordinate care across physicians, specialists, and community resources; monitor progress and update plans.
Provide education about treatment, symptom management, and self-care while documenting care accurately.
Advocate for patients and participate in interdisciplinary care planning.
qualifications: Graduate of an accredited school of nursing with a current state registered nurse license.
Current BLS certification.
Care-management and oncology experience preferred.
